label: Text → Gaussian splat (FLUX.3 Klein + IDOL)
description: Describe one object: FLUX.3 Klein makes a clean picture of it (whole object, white background), IDOL turns the picture into a 3D Gaussian splat, imported beside the scene, on the ground. Blender 5.3 renders it natively in every engine. Tested on 2026-11-15 with an olive tree in a pot: picture 38 s, splat 98 s, upright and facing the camera like the picture. Viewer shows the picture.

nodes.name: Prompt
nodes.label: Prompt
nodes.text: Studio product photo of a mature olive tree in a terracotta pot, the whole tree and pot visible with space around it, silver-green leaves, twisted trunk, plain pure white background, soft even studio light, sharp focus, no text

params.s: A cinematic, Dutch angle night shot of a retro hotel entrance illuminated by neon cyan and warm orange lights. A bellhop in uniform pulls a gold luggage cart with suitcases across a wet sidewalk. Inside the brightly lit, teal-toned glass lobby, two women in vintage uniforms stand near a wooden desk alongside tropical plants and a seated figure. The scene features a moody, stylized teal-and-orange color palette with strong neon reflections. Absolutely no text, no typography, no letters, no words, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no captions, pure imagery only.

nodes.name: Frame
nodes.label: How to use
nodes.text:
1. Describe ONE object in Prompt (whole,
   plain white background)
2. Run Graph: a picture, then the splat
3. Check the picture in Viewer
4. The splat is imported beside the scene:
   set Size on Import to Scene
5. Needs Blender 5.3 or later (native splats;
   5.2 keeps the .spz in the job folder)
